title: Quartic high precision embeddings
objective: Retain the authentic prepared integral-basis owner for x^4-2000022*x-2000042 and rebuild its 153088-bit roots and integral-basis embedding matrix with bit-exact PARI correspondence and independent tensor identities

oracles: Pristine PARI 2.17.4 packed roots and integral-basis embedding matrix

runs.summary: Four packed roots bit-exact; 15/16 M cells bit-exact; exact owner/tensor replay passed; GMP positive call 268.4 ms

handoff.summary: Captured the authentic prepared-nf basis owner atomically, rebuilt all 153088-bit quartic root components bit-exactly, and localized the remaining M discrepancy to one ulp in one of 16 cells.
risks: Full M is not yet claimed: make_M consumes pre-truncation get_roots guard words that are absent from exported nf roots.
next_steps: Port or retain the pre-truncation get_roots state at F->prec + F->extraprec, then re-run the existing bit-exact M oracle.
